shortDescription: By Nicole JaoExxon Mobil's NYSE:XOM 264,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Joliet, Illinois, experienced a power outage on Sunday afternoon, the company said on Monday.The cause of the power outage is under investigation, Exxon Mobil said in a statement.
